headline: Citrix urges urgent patch for critical NetScaler vulnerability
summary: Citrix is urging administrators to immediately patch a new critical vulnerability in NetScaler ADC and Gateway appliances, described as a remote code execution flaw with a 9.5 severity score. There is no word yet on whether it is being actively exploited.

claims.statement: Citrix is warning admins to immediately patch a new critical NetScaler vulnerability.

sources.quote: Citrix warns admins to patch new NetScaler RCE flaw immediately
Citrix gives NetScaler admins another critical reason to patch

claims.statement: The flaw is a remote code execution vulnerability affecting NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway products.

sources.quote: a new critical vulnerability affecting NetScaler ADC networking appliances and NetScaler Gateway secure remote access solutions

claims.statement: The vulnerability has a severity score of 9.5, with no word yet on active exploitation.

sources.quote: No word on exploitation status, but a 9.5 severity score suggests time is of the essence
